source: hand-written XTCE documents, shared as parser inputs
note: Eight XTCE documents: four valid and four deliberately invalid (a container cycle, a duplicate name, a wrong root element, unresolved references). They are language-neutral inputs, and they live here alongside the vectors that reference them. What a parser should produce from them is a tree rather than an octet string, which no vector kind expresses, so the expected parse results are not pinned here. A consumer can still check that the valid documents load and the invalid ones are refused.
